name: What is the difference between main water line repair and full replacement?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between main water line repair and full replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Main water line repair involves fixing a specific, localized issue, such as a small crack or a single burst section. Full replacement, however, entails excavating and installing an entirely new water line from the meter to your home's foundation. A practical tradeoff is that while repair is often quicker and less expensive initially, replacement offers a longer-term solution for aging or extensively damaged pipes, preventing future, recurring issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair fixes a specific problem, while replacement installs a new line. Repair is cheaper short-term, but replacement is a more durable solution for extensive damage.
